::: {#fig-logistic-function}

```{r}
#| label: logistic-function-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "The logistic function over the log-odds from -6 to 6, an S-shaped curve",
  "rising from near 0 on the left to near 1 on the right.",
  "Dotted horizontal lines mark the values 0 and 1,",
  "which the curve approaches but never reaches.",
  "Three points are marked, at log-odds -2, 0 and 2,",
  "with the middle one at height 0.5."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: logistic-function-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
# the Greek letter eta, written as a code point to keep this file ASCII
eta_symbol <- intToUtf8(0x3b7)
eta_grid <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = 241)
logistic_curve <- data.frame(eta = eta_grid, sigmoid = plogis(eta_grid))
logistic_points <- data.frame(eta = c(-2, 0, 2), sigmoid = plogis(c(-2, 0, 2)))
logistic_points$label <- sprintf("%.3f", logistic_points$sigmoid)

logistic_function_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0, 1),
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = logistic_curve,
    ggplot2::aes(x = eta, y = sigmoid),
    colour = "#0072B2"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = logistic_points,
    ggplot2::aes(x = eta, y = sigmoid),
    size = 3,
    colour = "#D55E00"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = logistic_points,
    ggplot2::aes(x = eta, y = sigmoid, label = label),
    nudge_x = 0.2,
    nudge_y = -0.06,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-6, 6, 2)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = paste0("Log-odds, ", eta_symbol),
    y = paste0("Probability, logistic(", eta_symbol, ")")
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(logistic_function_plot)
  )
} else {
  logistic_function_plot
}
```

The [logistic function](#def-logistic-function) for $\logodds$ from $-6$ to $6$.
Its [values](#def-value) lie strictly between $0$ and $1$, and the marked points are the values at $\logodds = -2$, $0$ and $2$ from @exm-logistic-function.

:::
